product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds large language models and document-processing engines for businesses to transform and automate their workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Paraphrases the company’s description of its LLM and document-processing products for businesses.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented in Upstage customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom lists Upstage in the 201–500 employee band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Seoul, South Korea as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Upstage says it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical build posts; the Dataverse article credits an AI Research Engineer, and the on-device LLM article is authored by a machine-learning engineer among its writers.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal links to multiple documentation sections and resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers site has live AI model development and AI engineer postings.

model_provider.notes: Upstage identifies its production models as developed by the company and publicly offers its Solar model family.

compliance_certs.notes: The company lists SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001/27701; only the requested certification names are included.

last_funding.notes: JB Financial subsidiaries agreed to invest KRW 40 billion in the Series C-2 round in October 2026; a funding profile reports this as approximately $30 million. The November 9 NVIDIA participation was still prospective.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2026 Series C-2 investment agreement is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers site lists an SDR (Sales Development Representative) opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage announced the launch of Upstage Studio on October 6, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 2026 report says Upstage reshuffled its C-suite, including bringing in Jin Yun-jeong as CFO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Upstage’s privacy policy names these systems in customer CRM, lead-management, customer-support, or service/marketing email functions.
